verdict.rationale: Algolia's relevance docs explicitly offer custom ranking to adapt results beyond text matching, and note that ranking draws on non-textual factors such as custom criteria and geolocation. Rules can override relevance (e.g. seasonal promotions, repositioning products), and Merchandising Studio and Personalization add boosting and user-level ranking. A community user corroborates ordering results by popularity or date. Missing for 10: the docs excerpts never detail how business attributes such as popularity, recency or margin are configured as ranking criteria, there is no in-depth first-party walkthrough of the ranking formula, and independent hands-on corroboration of tuning with margin-type signals is thin.
